After a winning spin, players can access the Gamble round by clicking the “X2” button. Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active. By activating this feature, the bet amount is multiplied by 5, and each spin is played with this increased bet amount.
When this bet is active, at least one 5X WILD symbol is guaranteed to appear on the very first spin. If the same WILD symbol still does not participate in a winning combination on the next spin, its multiplier will increase by another +1, and so on, until that WILD symbol participates in a winning combination.
During each new spin, if a new WILD symbol appears, its multiplier will always start at 5X, and the same rule described above will apply to it as well.If 2 WILD symbols participate in a winning combination, their multipliers are added together, and the payout for the winning line is calculated using the combined multiplier.
The WILD symbol(s) that participate in a winning combination are removed from the game board. However, if there is another WILD symbol on the board that does not participate in a winning combination, it will remain on the game board.
If the player stops playing or changes the bet, any existing WILD symbol or symbols and their multipliers from the already played ANTE BET will be saved. When the bet is changed, that WILD symbol and its multiplier will not carry over to another ANTE BET selection.
The player can stop playing with ANTE BET at any time by pressing the Disable button. In this case, the base bet amount will return to the value it had before ANTE BET was activated.

After spinning the Risk game wheel, if the player loses, they will receive one extra spin in the base game. If the player wins the Risk game spin, they will receive a bonus winning spin in the base game.
